The Hot Foods Act sounds compassionate, but let’s cut through the spin. SNAP already costs taxpayers $127 billion annually, yet 41% of benefits still flow to households above the poverty line. Instead of expanding entitlements, why not tackle the root cause: Biden-era inflation that’s forced 12% of Iowans onto food stamps? 

Real solutions mean slashing energy regulations that spiked grocery prices 23% since 2021 and axing redundant programs like the $4.3 billion Thrifty Food Plan bureaucracy. Fund warm meals by trimming waste—not adding to the deficit.
